reason: Indian directory libraries whose public catalog search showed no books in the recorded evidence. They are left out of finding a library (pop-up search, browse, near me and public API listings) until their catalogs show books. They stay resolvable by ID, so a reader who already chose one keeps it. A library with errors, a refusal or no test is never listed here.
restore: When a fresh check finds a book in a library's catalog, remove its ID from libraryIds, lower its platform count and the total, and update the expected counts in server/services/directory.test.js. See docs/research/india-library-status/README.md.

egranthalaya.criteria: needs-work-libraries.csv rows with emptyQueries 50 and failedQueries 0, less any library with a verified book in summary.json (egranthalaya:universities-iucaa passed the strict one-book check on 15 November 2026 and is listed again). The 11 libraries with request or setup errors are not listed.

libman.criteria: Tenants with no verified book in summary.json whose latest attempt across the four LIBMAN result files has at least one seed search, every seed search ok with zero records, and no candidate book. That is the 147 clean-empty tenants of the sweep plus the 8 host-busy tenants (libman:348, 353, 354, 355, 360, 361, 362, 363) that came back clean empty for science, history and india on recheck. Tenants with search errors and the excluded test or foreign tenants libman:202, 579 and 708 are not listed.
